free_tier_limits: Free plan: 40,000 Compute Units per day and 40 RPS; attribution required.
resolution_notes: pricing.free_tier_limits: auditor correct. Official pricing (https://moralis.com/pricing/) lists Free as 40,000 Compute Units per day and 40 RPS (not 40,000 CU/month); comparison table also marks Attribution required = Yes for Free. FAQ (https://moralis.com/faq/what-are-the-limits-for-api-requests/) likewise cites 40,000 CU per day for free tier.
